{'text': '科技專欄作家 Joanna Stern 上個月撰文講述，她發現自己在 Apple Books 上推出的正版著作《I Am Not a Robot》，短短幾日內已出現了十個仿冒版本。雖然她成功要求下架，但新的假書很快又再出現。', 'translate': 'Tech columnist Joanna Stern wrote an article last month recounting how she discovered that within just a few days of releasing her legitimate book "I Am Not a Robot" on Apple Books, ten counterfeit versions had already appeared. Although she successfully requested their takedown, new fake books soon reemerged.'}

{'text': '《紐約時報》記者 Kashmir Hill 在 Amazon 上找到一本講述她自己的假傳記，並發現這類由 AI 撰寫的傳記數以千計，全部都在平台上架發售……', 'translate': 'New York Times reporter Kashmir Hill found a fake biography about herself on Amazon, and discovered that there are thousands of such AI-written biographies, all listed for sale on the platform...'}

{'text': 'Stern 發現，大部分的仿冒書都是用 AI 快速生成的所謂「劣質內容」摘要，並附有虛構的作者名和出版社。', 'translate': 'Stern discovered that most of the counterfeit books were AI-generated so-called "slop" summaries produced rapidly, complete with fabricated author names and publishers.'}

{'text': '總的來說，我找到了十本明顯跟風我這本書的 AI 生成電子書，封面都由 AI 製作，模仿我正版封面的風格——採用同一種藍、黃、紅配色。大部分定價 9.99 美元，但有些賣到 20.99 美元。', 'translate': 'In total, I found ten AI-generated e-books clearly riding on the coattails of my book, with covers made by AI that mimic the style of my legitimate cover — using the same blue, yellow, and red color scheme. Most are priced at $9.99, but some sell for as much as $20.99.'}

{'text': '她表示自己成功要求 Apple 將這些假書下架，但很快又再出現了三本假書。', 'translate': 'She said she successfully got Apple to take down the fake books, but three more quickly reappeared.'}

{'text': 'Hill 發現寫她那本傳記的內容錯漏百出，所謂的作者和相片都是假的。', 'translate': 'Hill found that the biography written about her was riddled with errors, and the so-called author and photographs were all fake.'}

{'text': '計埋 Apple Books 同 Amazon，網上似乎有數以萬計的 AI 劣質內容假書流通。Hill 追查了其中一個製作 AI 傳記的人，對方聲稱自己用 ChatGPT 幾個小時就能炮製出 Hill 那本書的傳記。', 'translate': "Counting Apple Books and Amazon combined, there appear to be tens of thousands of AI slop fake books circulating online. Hill tracked down one of the people producing AI biographies, who claimed they could churn out Hill's biography in just a few hours using ChatGPT."}

{'text': '問題不止於電子書：Amazon 為作者提供按需印刷服務，即是說出版平裝本基本上是零成本。', 'translate': "The problem isn't limited to e-books: Amazon offers authors a print-on-demand service, meaning publishing a paperback is essentially cost-free."}

{'text': '9to5Mac 觀點', 'translate': '9to5Mac Opinion'}

{'text': '由社交媒體貼文到書籍，AI 劣質內容無處不在，而且情況只會越來越嚴重。目前來看，最佳的做法似乎是在購買前仔細查看評價，以及在有提供試閱的情況下先看樣章。', 'translate': 'From social media posts to books, AI slop is everywhere, and the situation is only going to get worse. For now, the best approach seems to be checking reviews carefully before purchasing, and reading sample chapters where previews are available.'}
